violations.why: ISR write can occur between task's write and subsequent read in fn_juniper.
ISR resets v_vessel after the check, then the task overwrites with 12 based on stale read.
ISR write between the check and the else-branch write makes the decision stale.
ISR can overwrite the value written at 34 before fn_nectar reads it.
ISR can overwrite the value written at 36 before fn_nectar reads it.
Two reads of v_vessel in the task can see different values if the ISR writes between them.
